subject.title: [Bug]: Subagent completion silently lost — no retry, no notification, no auto-restart on timeout

question: Should subagent completion failures be solved with a durable completion outbox/recovery contract, or should maintainers accept a narrower retry-and-notification mitigation first?
rationale: The source-reproducible failure crosses retry timing, duplicate prevention, session wake semantics, channel fallback, and timeout/restart recovery, so automation should not choose the permanent delivery policy by itself.

options.title: Design durable delivery first
options.body: Use this issue and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/67777 to settle the durable payload, retry, notification, and duplicate-prevention contract before landing a fix.

options.title: Ship a narrow mitigation
options.body: Allow https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90561 or a replacement to land only after conflicts are resolved and live requester-visible proof shows the intended failure signal.

options.title: Split remaining modes
options.body: Keep this broad issue as the umbrella and move parser, channel-specific, and sessions_yield deadlock variants into narrower linked issues.

recommendation.title: Design durable delivery first
recommendation.body: Use this issue and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/67777 to settle the durable payload, retry, notification, and duplicate-prevention contract before landing a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history on the subagent registry and announce lifecycle surfaces inspected.
